descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · S09 UAT step 3 as written: Generate, finish a task, complete and regenerate in tab B while the dashboard stays open in tab A

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U4 With the dashboard open, the counts update without a page reload when a note is generated or an encounter is completed (UAT TC-20; TFA-92598 AC 3; TFA-92598 How it works 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress
  • U1 With patients in a mix of pending / in-progress / complete states, the dashboard counts (Total, Pending, In Progress, Complete) match the real patient-list state, in Hospital and in Nursing Home (UAT TC-20; TFA-92598 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress
  • U8 Each Save Note and Generate run in TC-20 logs the AI call time (aiCallLog.providerMs) separately from the total (durationMs). Save Note targets 15 s or less in 9/10 runs. … (UAT 3.5)

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given The Hospital patient is seeded pre-rounded (already In Progress, so the 'seen' write at the Generate tap cannot move a count by itself) with 2 open tasks. The Nursing Home resident is In Today and pending. Tab A shows the dashboard and is never reloaded; …

When Hospital, in tab B: type encounter text and tap Generate Note & Finish; snapshot tab A while the note is still generating and again once the note shows. Tick one open task done; snapshot tab A. Tap Mark Encounter Complete (keep pending tasks); snapshot tab A. Tap Regenerate Note; …

Then Tab A changes without a reload. Hospital: while generating, the row does not claim a note. Once the note shows, the row's badge is Note Ready and the counts follow Q1. After the task, the row reads '1 task pending'. After completion: Total 1, Pending 0, In Progress 0, Complete 1. Nursing Home: Pending 1 until the note lands; …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT TC-20 step 3 + TFA-92598 AC 3. Every tab A checkpoint mustContain 'Rounding Dashboard' and the patient (the url check is a no-op, runnerNotes.url). Badges are judged inside the patient's row (runnerNotes.rowBadge), never page-wide, because the legend contains every badge word. Hospital while generating: rowBadgeNot Note Ready; counts recorded and judged after Q8. …

Where it ran: dev; test method MULTI · Multi-device / multi-account; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S09 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-20.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: MULTI · Multi-device / multi-account; secondary: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
